observations.body: A nephew exposes the plot against Paul. When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul. “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.
